name: Danaher Side Crucifix System
description: John Danaher’s Master The Move: The Side Crucifix covers underhooks, near-arm pinning, chancery and shin-pin attacks with kimuras, triangles and armbars.
summary: A focused side-crucifix course linking underhook acquisition and arm pinning to upper-body submissions.
overview:
Master The Move: The Side Crucifix by John Danaher concentrates on arm control and upper-body submissions from a side pin. Its six volumes cover obtaining the underhook, pinning the near-side arm and attacking through chancery or shin-pin positions.

This is a specialized course for top players who want more attacking depth from arm isolation after the pass.

related_content.name: Gordon Ryan Side Control to North-South System
related_content.relationship: For broader side-control retention, transitions to north-south and attacks from both pins.

flashcards.question: What two underhook-acquisition contexts does Danaher’s side-crucifix study distinguish?
flashcards.answer: Obtaining an underhook after settling in side control and obtaining it before side control, during an entry. The public outline gives these contexts separate sections.

products.best_for: Top players seeking a focused arm-isolation and submission course from side control.

guide.display_title: John Danaher: Side Crucifix and Arm Isolation

fits: You reach side control but struggle to obtain arm isolation for attacks.
You want a focused course on side-crucifix controls and submission branches.

includes: Underhook acquisition from side control, half guard, body-lock passing, turtle and knee-cut entries.
Near-side arm pinning, chancery and shin-pin positions.
Kimura, triangle and armbar branches, troubleshooting and a back-crucifix connection.
limits: This is a specialized side-crucifix curriculum, rather than a general course on side-control and north-south maintenance.
